The '''Far*Reach scout line''' was produced by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]], and was a popular product. The [[Far*Reach IV PQR]] was a heavily armed version of the Far*Reach scout line, and was used by the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]].
